A '''Separatist outpost''' was one of many [[Droid/Legends|droid]] outposts established on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. When [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] learned of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] going on the offensive in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-controlled territory, he sent [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] reinforcements to this [[CIS mobile command center|outpost]] in an attempt to secure his grip on the [[Felucia system/Legends|Felucia system]]. Soon after reinforcements arrived, the outpost became engulfed in a [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|battle]] which resulted in the destruction of all deployed battle droids and the base being captured by the Republic.

==History==
After the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] overwhelmed the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]]<ref name="HH">{{TCW|Holocron Heist}}</ref> at the [[First Battle of Felucia/Legends|First Battle of Felucia]],<ref name="Visual Guide Updated">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] installed several outposts on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], including this base run<ref name="Padawan Lost" /> by [[TZ-33/Legends|TZ-33]].<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode321.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Padawan Lost}}</ref>

The Republic eventually re-established a presence on Felucia thanks to the efforts of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who led their [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] on an offensive into Confederate territory. In retaliation, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] supplied this outpost with [[Droid/Legends|droid]] reinforcements to secure his hold on the [[Felucia system/Legends|system]] for the Confederacy. With added assistant from General [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and dividing their forces for different assaults on the outpost, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] troops were able to eliminate all droid forces and secure the base.<ref name="Padawan Lost" />
